description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the MRR@10 metric for different DPR configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)." and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and has a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick labels at 0.5 intervals. A black solid line with circle markers represents "DPR w/o query", starting at approximately 35.3 at x=1 and ending at approximately 35.7 at x=10, with a slight upward trend. A red solid line with circle markers represents “DPR w/ corpus expansion”, beginning at approximately 35.1 at x=1 and increasing to approximately 35.8 at x=10, generally trending upwards. A green solid line with triangle markers represents "DPR w/ document expansion”, starting at approximately 34.8 at x=1 and ending at approximately 35.2 at x=10, with fluctuating values around x=4 and x=8. A blue solid line with star markers represents “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion”, beginning at approximately 34.6 at x=1 and decreasing to approximately 34.3 at x=10, generally trending downwards.
